finding.summary: Dependants map now materializes every cell of every expanded whole-column/row range via `toSrefs`, which is O(rows×cols) per formula and can hang/OOM on realistic sheets
finding.evidence: memory.ts: `for (const r of toSrefs(extractReferences(expandUnboundedRanges(cell.f, bounds))))` (same in the three YorkieStore loops). `A:A` on a sheet with 50k used rows enumerates 50k srefs per formula, and the map is rebuilt on *every* edit (per the design doc). Previously ranges were user-sized; now a single `=SUM(A:A)` makes each keystroke's dependants rebuild linear in the sheet extent.
